verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated skills/routines/automations section. A Bot can save a multi-step path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule, for example "every weekday at 8:00 AM" (docs-4, docs-31). Routines can also be triggered by events (docs-32), and they run on a persistent cloud computer while the laptop is closed (docs-1). A month-long community user confirms that each bot owns its own routines (comm-2), and the runtime probe confirms the skills-routines-and-automations docs page exists (probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: hands-on independent corroboration of scheduled execution reliability specifically, and documented detail on schedule management (editing, pausing, run history).
